characters.name: Ananya Rao
characters.profile: Responsible for approving safety-related changes to demonstrations. She says she did not cancel Pulse's slot and did not authorize anyone to announce a cancellation.

characters.name: Karthik Menon
characters.profile: Managed the running order and announced that Pulse was cancelled. He says he received a phone confirmation from the faculty office shortly before making the announcement.

characters.name: Sana Ali
characters.profile: Answered calls at the event control desk. She says the desk received a brief call about a possible electrical issue, but she could not identify the caller.

characters.name: Dev Malhotra
characters.profile: Built Pulse and was due to demonstrate it. His team had argued with the stage team about a last-minute schedule change. He says he called the control desk to ask whether the slot was still on.

characters.name: Ritesh Shah
characters.profile: Responsible for stage audio and power distribution. He had raised a genuine concern about a loose cable earlier that afternoon, but says it was fixed before the demonstration.

characters.name: Meera Joshi
characters.profile: Works at the faculty office and manages its landline. She says the office phone rang during setup, but no one from the office spoke to Karthik to cancel the demonstration.
